data.name: Barthold
data.gender_notes: Barthold is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements beraht meaning 'brave' or 'bold' and hild meaning 'battle, battlefield'. The name Barthold is of German origin and is a compound of the Old High German elements beraht and hild. The name Barthold carries the meaning “Bold, brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barthold usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and bravery in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Barthold belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bold, brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barthold total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Barthold has its roots in the Old High German language, reflecting the rich cultural history of the Germanic peoples. It bears a strong connection to the valorous traditions of chivalry, courage, and militancy, which continue to hold a profound influence on Western civilization. The name carries an aura of strength, resilience, and heroism, relating to the noble warriors and valiant knights of the Middle Ages.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name Barthold is rooted in the aspirational values of bravery and readiness for battle, presently resonating with the biblical concept of spiritual warfare (2 Timothy 4:7). It serves as a reminder for us to be courageous, to stand firm in our faith (1 Corinthians 15:58), and to demonstrate God's love through our actions. This name is a constant reminder of the battles we face daily in our lives, rather than relying on our own power and strength, we can trust in God's divine protection and guidance, ultimately allowing us to address spiritual battles with faith, resilience, and a steady commitment to righteousness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Barthold carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Biblical tradition. As a name associated with Saint Bartholomew, it represents holiness, devotion, and Christian virtue.
